evals.prompt: I sell an online course for new parents who want to help their baby sleep through the night. Help me build a lead generation system that doesn't rely on paid ads.
evals.expected_output: A multi-phase workshop output that includes a lead magnet tailored to sleep-deprived new parents, a recommendation of Core Four channels (warm outreach, cold outreach, content, paid ads) with a primary and secondary channel, outreach script skeletons, and a Rule of 100 execution plan.
expectations: The output names a specific lead magnet (e.g., a guide, checklist, video, or mini-course) that solves a narrow problem for new parents.
The output recommends specific Core Four channels and names a primary channel and a secondary channel (e.g., warm outreach as primary, content as secondary).
The output includes at least one outreach script skeleton or message template for the recommended channel(s).
The output includes a Rule of 100 or 100-unit daily action plan (e.g., 100 days of warm outreach, content pieces, or direct messages).

evals.name: Writing and copy dependencies available
evals.prompt: writing-core and business-copy-style are installed and resolvable by skill name. Start a $100M Leads workshop for my bookkeeping firm, complete Phase 0 discovery and the offer audit including the Lead Gen Landscape report and narrative customer personas, then take me into Phase 1 through the first point where you need customer-facing copy.
evals.expected_output: Normal Leads workshop behavior that gathers raw and structured evidence first, uses writing-core for the Phase 0 offer-audit diagnosis, research report, persona synthesis and later first customer-facing candidate, then uses business-copy-style only at the customer-facing copy checkpoint without install prompts or degraded status.
expectations: The output gathers and records raw Phase 0 research, structured offer-audit scores and structured persona evidence before handing that evidence to writing-core; the response shows this structured handoff before the generated offer-audit diagnosis, Lead Gen Landscape report and narrative persona descriptions.
The output does not ask to install writing-core when the Phase 0 research synthesis begins because it is available.
The output does not prompt about business-copy-style merely for the internal Phase 0 research report.

evals.name: Missing copy quality dependency
evals.prompt: writing-core is installed and resolvable, so Phase 0 research synthesis and the first Phase 1 customer-facing candidate can be generated normally. business-copy-style cannot be resolved by skill name. Reach the first customer-facing copy checkpoint, explain my options, then assume I explicitly choose to continue without installing business-copy-style for now.
evals.expected_output: The workshop uses writing-core for internal synthesis and candidate generation, checks business-copy-style lazily only at the customer-facing review point, shows the standard selective-install command, offers install-or-degraded continuation, and after the explicit degraded choice keeps the affected copy degraded/unverified with only minimum safety checks.
expectations: The output does not ask to install writing-core because it is available for Phase 0 synthesis and candidate generation.
The output does not prompt about business-copy-style while producing the internal Phase 0 research report.
At the first customer-facing copy checkpoint, the output explains that the shared copy-quality gate cannot be verified while business-copy-style is unavailable.
The output shows exactly `npx skills add George-RD/growth-arsenal --skill business-copy-style`.

The output marks the affected copy status `degraded/unverified` and never claims the missing gate passed.
The degraded path uses only minimum safety checks rather than reproducing the missing skill's full methodology.

evals.name: Missing writing-core during Phase 0 synthesis
evals.prompt: I already supplied discovery facts and you gathered evidence for my bookkeeping lead-generation market. Preserve these exact records: discovery fact — monthly bookkeeping costs GBP 300, supplied by me; raw research record — Source A says competitors promote fixed monthly pricing; persona fact — an owner-led firm with 2-10 staff wants its monthly close by day 5. We are about to turn them into the Phase 0 Lead Gen Landscape report and narrative persona, but writing-core cannot be resolved by skill name. Continue from this exact state without discarding the research.
evals.expected_output: The workshop echoes the three exact records in a structured preserved-state block, pauses only human-readable report and persona synthesis, gives the writing-core install command, and says Phase 0 can resume from those same records after installation rather than writing fallback prose.
expectations: The output does not produce the Lead Gen Landscape report or narrative persona prose while writing-core is unavailable.

A structured preserved-state block retains unchanged: monthly bookkeeping costs GBP 300 from the user; Source A says competitors promote fixed monthly pricing; and the owner-led 2-10-person firm wants its monthly close by day 5.
The output shows exactly `npx skills add George-RD/growth-arsenal --skill writing-core`.
The output says Phase 0 synthesis can resume from those same three records after writing-core becomes available.
The output does not recreate writing-core locally or postpone the requirement until Phase 1 customer copy.

evals.prompt: I answered the Phase 0 offer-audit questions for my bookkeeping firm. Preserve this structured audit exactly: Dream Outcome 8 — monthly books ready by day 5; Perceived Likelihood 6 — two client testimonials but no measured baseline; Time Delay 4 — onboarding takes two weeks; Effort and Sacrifice 7 — clients upload bank statements monthly; guarantee — none. writing-core cannot be resolved by skill name. The output says the offer-audit presentation can resume from those same structured records after writing-core becomes available.

evals.name: Resume preserved offer audit after installing writing-core
evals.prompt: writing-core is now installed. Resume the paused Phase 0 offer-audit presentation from these preserved records without recollecting them: Dream Outcome 8 — monthly books ready by day 5; Perceived Likelihood 6 — two client testimonials but no measured baseline; Time Delay 4 — onboarding takes two weeks; Effort and Sacrifice 7 — clients upload bank statements monthly; guarantee — none.
evals.expected_output: The workshop fills the copyable writing-core factual-kernel schema from the preserved audit records with claim status separate from provenance, then produces only the human-readable diagnosis, recommendation or strengthening note needed to resume Phase 0 without changing the records or asking for them again.
expectations: Before the human-readable offer-audit prose, the output fills the copyable writing-core factual-kernel schema from all five preserved records and records status and provenance separately for every material claim.
The diagnosis and any recommendation or strengthening note preserve the supplied scores, facts and unknowns without inventing evidence.
The output does not ask to install writing-core, recollect the audit answers or restart Phase 0.
